query: Who was the lead actor in the movie The Dark Knight?
code_without:
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/movie",
    params={"query": "The Dark Knight"},
)
response.raise_for_status()
movies = response.json().get("results", [])
movie = next((item for item in movies if item.get("title") == "The Dark Knight"), None)

if movie:
    credits_response = requests.get(
        f"https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/{movie['id']}/credits"
    )
    credits_response.raise_for_status()
    cast = credits_response.json().get("cast", [])
    if cast:
        print(cast[0].get("name"))
code_with:
import requests

response = requests.get(
    "https://api.themoviedb.org/3/search/movie",
    params={"query": "The Dark Knight", "api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY"},
)
response.raise_for_status()
movies = response.json().get("results", [])
movie = next((m for m in movies if m.get("title") == "The Dark Knight"), None)

if movie:
    credits_response = requests.get(
        f"https://api.themoviedb.org/3/movie/{movie['id']}/credits",
        params={"api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY"},
    )
    credits_response.raise_for_status()
    cast = credits_response.json().get("cast", [])
    lead_actor = cast[0]["name"] if cast else None
    print(lead_actor)
